title: Claude Code Finds Planet Candidate in 7 Years of NASA Data
summary:
P. Rabtsevich wrote more than 1,000 scripts to scan space archives for an undocumented celestial object, identifying a new planet candidate. To perform the analysis, the researcher used Claude Code with the Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1 models to search through 7 years of telescope data that had previously gone unexamined for this discovery.

NASA has approved a formal request for telescope time to verify the findings after reviewing the researcher's data. This next step will provide the observational verification needed to confirm the existence of the planet.
